verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of installer options, partitioning, dual-boot support, or coexistence with another OS; all cited docs cover desktop features (containers, apps, VMs) and community comments unrelated to installation setup. This is an applicable axis for an OS product, but no evidence supports it. Missing for 10: any documentation or community report about the Anaconda installer's dual-boot/partitioning support, coexistence with Windows/other OS, or bootloader handling.
